server.description: The forge: the code sandbox, a runtime of its own where a generated plugin is written, compiled on an import allow-list, tested, checked by code (types under Generated., a signature the substrate validates and the units service resolves, a card), loaded by sha256 and run like on the twin; a signed artifact is proposed to the station, never pushed
server.instructions: In order: plugin_template (read it once), plugin_write (src/index.ts exporting register(registry, doc), src/<name>.node.ts, src/<name>.test.ts, docs/<name>.md), plugin_build, plugin_test, plugin_load; then registry_search, document_build and session_run see the new types, and graph.evaluate can target this slot. plugin_promote proposes the artifact to the station with the evaluate report that judged it. Imports: @spiky-panda/core and the plugin's own files; tests may import node:test and node:assert. A generated type is named under Generated. and never overrides one the registry holds.

plugin_template.title: Plugin template
plugin_template.description: A complete minimal plugin exactly as the substrate accepts it (a gain: the entry with register(registry, doc), the node class on RuntimeNode with its ports, an editable, a viewable, fire reading the session's signals and publishing, the test, the card). Read it before writing a plugin, and write yours on its shape.

plugin_write.title: Write a plugin
plugin_write.description: The files of a generated plugin into the task's workshop: sources under src/ (the entry index.ts exporting register(registry, doc), the node files, the test files), the documentation cards under docs/. The layout and the imports are checked as they are written; a refusal names the file and the rule.

plugin_build.title: Build a plugin
plugin_build.description: Compile the plugin in a child process with a time budget, after the import allow-list (@spiky-panda/core and the plugin's own files; node:test and node:assert in tests). The diagnostics come back whole: file, line, code, message.

plugin_test.title: Test a plugin
plugin_test.description: The plugin's own tests (node's runner, a child process, a time budget) and the deterministic checks on a scratch registry: every type under Generated., a signature present and valid for the substrate, every unit resolved by the units service against its quantity, the card on disk. Both must pass before the plugin is loaded.

plugin_load.title: Load a plugin
plugin_load.description: Load the built and tested plugin into the forge's registry, by its sha256. Refused before a positive plugin_test; a type the registry already holds is never overridden. From then on registry_search, document_build and session_run see its types.

plugin_promote.title: Propose a plugin
plugin_promote.description: Write the signed artifact of a loaded plugin (files and sha256, types, tests and checks, the evaluate report named) and propose it to the station, and nowhere else: Mother keeps it, the commander authorises, the twin loads the generated plugin. The forge never pushes.

forge://plugins.description: The plugins loaded in the forge: id, sha256, types, files, provenance (task and plugin name).

forge://builds.description: Every compilation, passed or refused, with its diagnostics; the tests and checks run on it.

forge://proposals.description: Every artifact proposed to the station, with the station's proposal id.
